body.description: vscode spike 6.1 logs probe, safe to delete
body.config_yaml:
input:
  generate:
    interval: 1s
    mapping: 'root = {"n": counter()}'
pipeline:
  processors:
    - log:
        level: INFO
        message: 'vscode-spike-logs info ${! this.n }'
    - log:
        level: WARN
        message: 'vscode-spike-logs warn ${! this.n }'
        fields_mapping: 'root.probe_n = this.n'
output:
  drop: {}
